name: Live

name: AI - W5 Stated vs Enforced
description: Identities where robots.txt and the edge disagree
description - details: robots.txt allows the crawler but the homepage refuses it, or the reverse. Cloudflare and Akamai may refuse a vendor UA sent from a non-vendor network (spoof detection).

name: AI - M1 Sitemap Declared
description: Whether robots.txt names a sitemap

name: AI - M2 Sitemap Works
description: Whether the sitemap loads and is valid XML
description - details: Reads the first robots-declared sitemap, else `/sitemap.xml`.

name: AI - M2 Sitemap URL
description: The sitemap address M2 read

name: AI - M2 Sitemap Items
description: Entries listed directly in that sitemap
description - details: Child sitemaps for an index (not fetched).

name: AI - M3 Newest lastmod
description: Newest `<lastmod>` in that sitemap

name: AI - M4 llms.txt
description: Whether `/llms.txt` exists and is well formed
description - details: Catalog v0.1 wants an H1 and a `>` summary; the llmstxt.org spec requires only the H1.

name: AI - M4 llms.txt Status
description: Status code for `/llms.txt`

name: AI - R1 Text Without JavaScript
description: Whether real text arrives without running scripts

name: AI - R1 Words
description: Visible words in the plain HTTP page
description - details: In `<main>` if present, else `<body>`.

name: AI - R3 H1 Count
description: Number of `<h1>` headings

name: AI - I1 Meta Description
description: Whether a useful meta description exists
description - details: pass at 50+ characters and not a CMS default.

name: AI - I2 Open Graph
description: Whether og:title, og:description and og:site_name exist
description - details: All three = pass, one or two = partial.

name: AI - I3 Structured Data
description: Whether schema.org data says this is a government

name: AI - I3 Schema Types
description: schema.org types found

name: AI - I4 Names Agree
description: Whether the page names itself the way the registry does

name: AI - I5 On CISA .gov List
description: Whether the host is on CISA's .gov list

name: AI - D1 Open Data Linked
description: Whether the homepage links to an open data portal
description - details: Portals listed in `data/ai-readability/portals.json`.

name: AI - D1 Portal Links
description: Number of open data portal links on the homepage

name: AI - F1 Current Year
description: Whether the newest printed year is this year or last

name: AI - F1 Newest Year
description: Newest copyright or 'updated' year printed

name: AI - P2 Civic Vendors
description: Civic platforms the homepage links to
description - details: Legistar, Granicus, eCode360, ArcGIS Hub, and others.

name: AI - P3 Translation Widget
description: Whether a translation widget is on the page

name: AI - P3 hreflang Count
description: Number of `hreflang` alternate links

name: AI - P4 Third-Party Scripts
description: Distinct outside hosts that serve scripts to the homepage
description - details: Scripts only, so smaller than GSA's `third_party_service_count`. The host names are kept private.

name: AI - V1 Headless Own Name Status
description: Homepage status in headless Chrome (headless_default)
description - details: `headless_default` sends the browser's own UA (contains `HeadlessChrome`); `headless_as_chrome` is the same browser with only that word changed.

name: AI - V1 Headless Own Name Verdict
description: Whether headless Chrome (headless_default) got the real page
description - details: pass / blocked / na.

name: AI - V1 Headless As Chrome Status
description: Homepage status in headless Chrome (headless_as_chrome)
description - details: `headless_default` sends the browser's own UA (contains `HeadlessChrome`); `headless_as_chrome` is the same browser with only that word changed.

name: AI - V1 Headless As Chrome Verdict
description: Whether headless Chrome (headless_as_chrome) got the real page
description - details: pass / blocked / na.

name: AI - V1 Name Decides
description: Whether only the declared browser name changed the answer
description - details: TRUE if the browser was blocked under its own name and let in as `Chrome`.

name: AI - V1 Rendered Words
description: Visible words after the page's scripts ran
description - details: From `headless_as_chrome`. Compare with `ai_r1_words`.

name: AI - Abhi-12 Score
description: Score on Abhi Nemani's 12-row scorecard
description - details: Pass 1, partial 0.5, fail, blocked and na 0, out of 12.

name: AI - BetaNYC Score
description: The same score over only the rows we could measure
description - details: Blocked rows are left out, not counted as fail. Read with `ai_betanyc_measured_rows`.

name: AI - BetaNYC Measured Rows
description: How many of the 12 rows could be measured

name: AI - Review Notes
description: Notes this site left on the run's review list
description - details: Pushback, errors and oddities to look at by hand.

name: AI - Reach Checked
description: Whether reach_check.py looked at this site
description - details: Only sites the run could not read (W4 na, blocked or fail) are checked; blank reach columns on other sites mean not checked.

name: AI - Reach Diagnosis
description: Why the site could not be read
description - details: One of: `dns_missing` The name does not resolve; neither does the www or bare variant.; `dns_alt_host_only` The name does not resolve, but the www or bare variant does.; `no_server` The name resolves, but nothing answers on port 443 or 80.; `http_only` Nothing answers on 443; plain http on 80 answers.; `bad_certificate_http_ok` The certificate fails to verify; plain http answers.; `bad_certificate` The certificate fails to verify; plain http does not answer.; `tls_fails_http_ok` The TLS handshake fails; plain http answers.; `tls_fails` The TLS handshake fails; plain http does not answer.; `refuses` HTTPS answers with 401, 403, 429 or 503.; `answers_now` HTTPS answers with a 2xx or 3xx status now.; `error_status` HTTPS answers with another 4xx or 5xx status.; `https_error` TLS verified, but the HTTPS request itself failed.; `unclear` None of the above.

name: AI - Reach DNS Resolves
description: Whether the site's host name resolves

name: AI - Reach Alternate Host
description: The www or bare variant that resolves instead
description - details: Set only when the listed name does not resolve.

name: AI - Reach TLS
description: Whether the HTTPS certificate verified
description - details: `ok`, `bad_cert` or `error` (handshake failed). Blank if nothing answered on 443.

name: AI - Reach TLS Detail
description: Why the certificate or handshake failed
description - details: For example `certificate has expired` or `Hostname mismatch`.

name: AI - Reach HTTPS Status
description: Status of GET / over verified HTTPS
description - details: Redirects not followed.

name: AI - Reach HTTP Status
description: Status of GET / over plain http
description - details: Redirects not followed. A 301 to https is normal.

name: AI - Reach Checked At
description: When reach_check.py ran for this site
description - details: UTC.

name: AI - Retest Run
description: The later run that probed this site again
description - details: Blank if the site was not retested.

name: AI - Retest W4 Verdict
description: W4 verdict in the retest run
description - details: Compare with `ai_w4_verdict` to tell a passing glitch from a lasting failure.

name: AI - Person Check
description: Whether a visible Chrome visited this site
description - details: headed_check.py, for sites that turned every crawler away. Blank if not checked.

name: AI - Person Verdict
description: Did a visible Chrome, under its own name, get the homepage?
description - details: pass = 200 and not a challenge page; blocked otherwise; na = no answer. A pass here with a blocked `ai_w4_verdict` means the site blocks bots, not people.

name: AI - Person Status
description: HTTP status Chrome received for the homepage

name: AI - Person Challenge
description: Chrome was shown a challenge or block page
description - details: Automated Chrome is detectable (navigator.webdriver). A challenge here may still let a person by hand through.

name: AI - Person Vantage
description: The machine and connection used

name: AI - Person Abhi-12 Score
description: The 12-row score on what Chrome received
description - details: Same scoring as `ai_abhi12_score`. The agent-reachability row stays 0 here, because crawlers were turned away. Blank unless the person check passed.

name: AI - Person W1 Verdict
description: W1 verdict on what Chrome received
description - details: Blank unless the person check passed.

name: AI - Person M2 Verdict
description: M2 verdict on what Chrome received
description - details: Blank unless the person check passed.

name: AI - Person M4 Verdict
description: M4 verdict on what Chrome received
description - details: Blank unless the person check passed.

name: AI - Person R1 Verdict
description: R1 verdict on what Chrome received
description - details: Blank unless the person check passed.

name: AI - Person I1 Verdict
description: I1 verdict on what Chrome received
description - details: Blank unless the person check passed.

name: AI - Person I2 Verdict
description: I2 verdict on what Chrome received
description - details: Blank unless the person check passed.

name: AI - Person I3 Verdict
description: I3 verdict on what Chrome received
description - details: Blank unless the person check passed.

name: AI - Person D1 Verdict
description: D1 verdict on what Chrome received
description - details: Blank unless the person check passed.
